none: PAS ESS-077C87: Roman samian ware vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman vessel: Roman vessel: Samian ware cup, form 35 in Hartley 'Samian ware or terra sigillata' chapter VIII in Collingwood and Richmond (1969 edition) The Archaeology of Roman Britain. No potters stamp is present. The curved rim is decorated with stylised leaves en barbotine: a thick clay slip was trailed onto the surface of the vessel in the form of tear-drop shaped leaves with a curved stem.…
